# Performance Checklist: G56R-004 Policy Controls and Adaptive Comparators

**Purpose**: Validate that requirements for mirrored smoke ceilings, raw-token
identity, cache diagnostics, elapsed wall-clock scope, objective attempts, and
pairwise cache isolation are complete, unambiguous, consistent, and measurable
before task generation.
**Created**: 2026-07-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Depth**: Standard | **Audience**: Reviewer (PR) | **Focus**: performance
requirements named in the domain prompt.

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based
on feature context and requirements. It tests the requirements, not the
implementation.

## Smoke Ceiling Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all mirrored smoke ceilings enumerated with frozen values:
      objective attempts, repetition, confirmation entries, elapsed time, raw
      token ceiling, component token ceilings, cache read, and cache write by
      TTL class? [Completeness, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK002 Are all smoke ceiling units and comparison directions required to
      be declared rather than inferred from field names? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK003 Is the parent-plus-children counting scope required for every smoke
      ceiling? [Coverage, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK004 Is a common breach disposition attached to every mirrored smoke
      ceiling, including token, cache, component, objective, repetition,
      confirmation, and elapsed-time ceilings? [Closed by Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK005 Is the non-scored nature of smoke evidence specified so ceiling
      breaches refuse smoke evidence rather than producing scored outcome rows?
      [Consistency, Spec §FR-035, Spec §FR-036]

## Raw-Token Identity

- [x] CHK006 Is the 1,000,000 raw-token ceiling expressed as a named member, not
      only as prose? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications Session 3, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK007 Are the three bounded raw-token summands specified as exactly
      800,000 input, 150,000 cached input, and 50,000 output tokens?
      [Completeness, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK008 Is the arithmetic identity
      `800,000 + 150,000 + 50,000 == 1,000,000` required in measurable success
      criteria, with cache diagnostic ceilings and reasoning output excluded?
      [Closed by Spec §SC-014]
- [x] CHK009 Are reasoning output tokens required to be reported while excluded
      from dominance and the raw-token ceiling calculation? [Consistency,
      Spec §FR-022, Contract §Policy Control Registry]
- [x] CHK010 Are raw-token, component-token, and diagnostic-cache quantities
      distinguished so a validator cannot admit the wrong ceiling into the
      identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-036]

## Cache Diagnostic Ceilings

- [x] CHK011 Are cache read and cache write defined as diagnostic quantities
      outside dominance and outside the raw-token identity? [Completeness,
      Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK012 Is cache read checked only against the `1,200,000 cache-read token`
      ceiling? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK013 Are cache write quantities checked by their own TTL-class ceilings:
      160,000 five-minute cache-write tokens and 40,000 one-hour cache-write
      tokens? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK014 Is missing or unobserved cache evidence required to remain
      `unobserved` rather than pass, fail as zero, or be coerced to zero?
      [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, Spec §Clarifications Session 3]
- [x] CHK015 Does the plan assign explicit test ownership for distinct cache
      read/write ceilings and unobserved-rather-than-zero handling? [Closed by
      Plan §Test Ownership]

## Elapsed Time And Objective Attempts

- [x] CHK016 Is the 30-minute smoke ceiling stated as 1,800 seconds and scoped to
      each control? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK017 Is the 30-minute ceiling specified as elapsed wall clock over the
      whole parent-plus-children unit, not additive duration summed across
      members? [Closed by Spec §FR-036]
- [x] CHK018 Are child dispatches excluded from objective-attempt consumption so
      the five-attempt limit counts non-reserved parent objectives only?
      [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications Session 3]
- [x] CHK019 Do success criteria measure elapsed wall-clock scope and
      child-dispatch attempt exclusion rather than only repeating the 30-minute
      and five-objective values? [Closed by Spec §SC-014]
- [x] CHK020 Does the plan distinguish live smoke elapsed-time ceilings from
      deterministic replay duration dimensions? [Consistency, Plan §Performance
      Goals, Plan §Test Ownership]

## Pairwise Cache Isolation

- [x] CHK021 Is cache isolation required across all three unordered pairs of the
      three controls rather than only consecutive smoke runs? [Coverage,
      Spec §FR-038, Spec §SC-016]
- [x] CHK022 Is `observed_disjoint` with both root digests present the only
      accepted isolation status? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038]
- [x] CHK023 Are shared, unobserved, path-based, and missing-root evidence
      dispositions specified as invalidating affected smoke evidence?
      [Completeness, Spec §FR-038]
- [x] CHK024 Are root values required to be committed as digests rather than raw
      filesystem paths? [Coverage, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-039]
- [x] CHK025 Does the plan assign explicit test ownership for all three unordered
      cache-isolation pairs and their invalidating dispositions? [Closed by Plan
      §Test Ownership]

## Acceptance Criteria And Traceability

- [x] CHK026 Do measurable outcomes cover every smoke-bound family: objectives,
      repetition, confirmation entries, elapsed time, raw tokens, component
      tokens, and cache diagnostics? [Traceability, Spec §SC-014]
- [x] CHK027 Do measurable outcomes distinguish authorized, refused, unrun, and
      incomplete smoke states so performance evidence is not inferred?
      [Coverage, Spec §Clarifications Session 3, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK028 Is every performance requirement traceable to implementation-owned
      tests rather than live smoke execution? [Traceability, Plan §Testing,
      Plan §Test Ownership]

## Remediation Record

**Initial counts**: 28 items, 6 requirements defects found by deterministic
`count-markers` gaps mode.

**Gap remediation**:
- CHK004 closed by requiring every smoke ceiling to declare breach disposition
  and sealing any bound breach as refused with the breached member and observed
  value retained. Source: Spec §FR-036 and CAR-004 validator precedent.
- CHK008 closed by moving the raw-token arithmetic identity into measurable
  success criteria and excluding reasoning output plus cache diagnostics from
  that identity. Source: Spec §SC-014 and CAR-004 SC-017/SC-028 precedent.
- CHK015 closed by assigning Layer 4 ownership for distinct cache read/write
  ceilings and unobserved-rather-than-zero cache diagnostics. Source: Plan
  §Test Ownership and existing `test-policy-control-contracts.py` coverage
  pattern.
- CHK017 closed by making the 30-minute / 1,800-second cap elapsed wall clock
  over the parent-plus-children unit, not additive duration. Source: Spec
  §FR-036 and CAR-004 FR-030b precedent.
- CHK019 closed by adding elapsed wall-clock scope and child-dispatch attempt
  exclusion to SC-014. Source: Spec §SC-014 and CAR-004 SC-029 precedent.
- CHK025 closed by assigning Layer 4 ownership for all three unordered
  cache-isolation pairs and invalidating dispositions. Source: Plan §Test
  Ownership and CAR-004 SC-031 precedent.
